motion.wavelength_sampling: Native wavelength map at predicted source; nearest registered pixel
motion.note: Widest baseline among available same-detector exposures within 0.025 µm. Loaded subset only; this is not the widest-baseline archive proof. Difference B − A is unscaled, without PSF matching. Prediction includes proper motion and geometric annual parallax; radial velocity and perspective acceleration are omitted. Gaussian centroids require S/N ≥8 and fit-quality checks. Error includes a 0.2-pixel component floor; no field-star astrometric registration or calibration-systematic correction. Widest comparable available span: 360.399 days.
motion.measurement_reason: No comparable pair has two reliable unflagged PSF fits. Native PSF fit rejected (S/N 5.4, reduced chi-square 49.0); no reliable centroid.

rw.note: Same detector and 0.025 micrometer wavelength group; statistical errors only. A fixed common footprint of unflagged registered pixels excludes masked cores in every epoch; values are a brightness index, not total source flux. No masked values are filled or interpolated. PSF, calibration, crowding and residual wavelength effects can mimic variability; this curve alone does not establish intrinsic stellar variability.

rdraconis.error: Load repeated exposures in one 0.025 micrometer detector/wavelength group. No cross-band curve is substituted.
